data.name: Substrate Biochar
data.description: Substrate Biochar is a UK-registered carbon-removal startup whose leadership combines carbon engineering and industrial project expertise in southern Africa. It partners with large-scale biomass suppliers, converting waste sawdust and forestry offcuts via pyrolysis into biochar, carbon removals, heat and electrical power. Credits are issued under the Rainbow methodology.
